25.explanation: The Rio documents (July 2025) rejected unilateral, discriminatory measures 'under the pretext of environmental concerns, such as … carbon border adjustment mechanisms' (the EU's CBAM).

26.explanation: Indonesia became a full BRICS member in January 2025, and Rio was its first summit as a member.

27.explanation: Goldman Sachs economist Jim O'Neill coined 'BRIC' in 2001.

28.explanation: The New Development Bank is headquartered in Shanghai.

29.explanation: India took the BRICS chairship for 2026 and hosts the 18th summit.

30.explanation: The P5 are the US, UK, France, Russia and China. India is not a permanent member.

31.explanation: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act, 1962 lets the US President impose tariffs on national-security grounds, a common basis for unilateral tariffs (e.g. steel and aluminium). None of the other options is a tariff law.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act

32.explanation: The August 2025 US tariffs of up to 50% on Indian goods exempted pharmaceuticals (and some electronics), while textiles, auto parts and handicrafts were hit.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Tariffs in the second Trump administration

33.explanation: The Indo-Pacific strategy aims at a free, open and rules-based maritime order.

34.explanation: The extra 25% 'penalty' tariff on India (August 2025) was justified by India's continued purchases of Russian oil (and defence equipment).

sources.title: Wikipedia: Tariffs in the second Trump administration

35.explanation: Malabar is the naval exercise of the Quad countries: India, US, Japan and Australia.

36.explanation: The US is India's largest export market, taking about 18–20% of merchandise exports (about $86.5 bn of $437 bn in FY25).

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce export data FY2024-25

37.explanation: IMD calls it a cloudburst when 10 cm (100 mm) or more of rain falls in an hour over a small area.

38.explanation: Doppler radars measure reflectivity (precipitation intensity) and radial velocity (wind and motion).

40.explanation: Under s.3 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005 the Prime Minister is the ex-officio Chairperson of the NDMA.

41.explanation: Orographic lift is air forced upward by mountains, which cools it and produces intense rain.

42.explanation: IMD, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, issues official weather forecasts and warnings.

43.explanation: Jan Železný (Czech Republic) holds the men's javelin world record of 98.48 m (1996).

44.explanation: The men's javelin weighs 800 g (women's 600 g).

45.explanation: The AFI declared 7 August, the day of Neeraj Chopra's Tokyo gold in 2021, National Javelin Day.

46.explanation: Abhinav Bindra won India's first individual Olympic gold (10 m air rifle, Beijing 2008).

47.explanation: Tokyo hosted the 2025 World Athletics Championships in September 2025.

48.explanation: The Rapid Action Force is a specialised riot-control wing of the CRPF.

49.explanation: A Maha Kumbh comes after 12 Purna Kumbhs (12 × 12 years), so once every 144 years. Prayagraj held one in 2025.

50.explanation: The four Kumbh venues are Prayagraj, Haridwar, Ujjain and Nashik. Varanasi is not one of them.

51.explanation: The 29 January 2025 crush (Mauni Amavasya) happened near the Sangam Nose.

sources.title: Wikipedia: 2025 Prayag Maha Kumbh crowd crush

52.explanation: Methyl isocyanate (MIC) leaked from the Union Carbide plant in Bhopal in December 1984.
